scheme_name: Reimbursement of Expenditure for Occupational Diseases (P.B.O.C.W.W.B)
other_conditions: Applicant must be a resident of Punjab
Applicant must be a Building/Construction Worker (Unorganised Worker)
Applicant must have engaged in building and construction work for at least 90 days in a given year
Applicant must have a monthly income of ₹15,000 or below
Applicant must not be a member of any other Welfare Fund established under any law
Applicant must not be a member of EPF, NPS, or ESIC
Applicant must not be an income tax payer
For scheme application, applicant must be a registered member under the Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board of Punjab or a family member of such a worker
Treatment expenditure must be verified by the Civil Surgeon
Applicant must have exhausted ₹50,000 benefit under the Bhagat “Puran Singh Sehat Beema Yojna” scheme
benefits_summary: Provides reimbursement up to ₹1,00,000 or actual expenses (whichever is lower) for treatment of specified occupational diseases, after exhausting ₹50,000 under the Bhagat Puran Singh Sehat Beema Yojna scheme.
